annotations.title: Get the Choghadiya and Hora for a day

description: Calculates the Choghadiya of a day in a city: the eight day periods from sunrise and the eight night periods from sunset, each with its name, start and end time and what it is traditionally used for, plus the 24 planetary horas. Use it when someone asks for today's Choghadiya, the current Choghadiya or Hora, or the good time slots of a day. Times are in the city's own time zone. Covers today by default, or another date.

date.description: Optional. The day as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in that city. Convert the person's own wording to this form; if an all-number date could be read two ways, ask which number is the day.

latitude.description: Optional. Latitude of the city in decimal degrees, north positive. Give it only together with longitude, when the user supplied coordinates or the place could not be found by name.

longitude.description: Optional. Longitude of the city in decimal degrees, east positive. Give it only together with latitude.

place.description: City and country, for example "Ahmedabad, India".
